subject: Problem in Rattle 4.0.0 (and prior) with hierarchical clustering an Linux

messages.author: d36a49e6da3ad7a2
messages.subject: Problem in Rattle 4.0.0 (and prior) with hierarchical clustering an Linux
parts:
Hello,

there is an anoying bug when you try to do a hierarchical cluater analysis in the linux (CentOS 7) version of rattle:
If you call the clustering procedure you'll get the warning:

Error in parse(text = hclust.cmd) :
  <text>:2:0: unerwartetes Ende der Eingabe
1: crs$hclust <-
   ^

Contact sup...@togaware.com.

Please supply the output of rattleInfo() and the steps required to replicate the problem.

Rattle 4.0.0


If you do the same with the windows version everythiong ist fine. Strange ...
Any idea for a workaround?

Kind regards,
Michael
